Problem Description
: Charger is not working after update
Troubleshooting
:
Upon review, the charger is displaying an "SCB Offline" status, indicating that the charger has not re-established connection with the SCB. Unfortunately, without this connection, remote troubleshooting options are limited.
If the charger is online on the OCPP backend, we kindly request that you initiate a hard reset via the OCPP interface (assuming the charger is connected to the OCPP server). Alternatively, performing a local reboot may resolve the issue and bring the charger back online.
Should a site visit be necessary to restore the charger’s functionality, we recommend carrying LiveLinux and CFast to assist in the process.
For future reference, your case number is
0408741
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon
